newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Hansapank tops Estonia market, index at new high.
newsitem.headline: Hansapank tops Estonia market, index at new high.

text.p: Shares in leading bank Hansapank topped the activity list on the Estonian share market on Friday and the market index reached a new high, dealers said.
Hansapank turned over a healthy 8.2 million kroons out of the overall official list volume of 16.7 million kroons.
Hansapank ended 0.25 kroons higher at 105.25 kroons as the Tallinn stock exchange index ended up 1.01 percent at 105.28.

Other bank shares also made gains, with Savings Bank turning over 2.8 million kroons and climbing from 38.43 kroons to 39.40 and Tallinna Pank ending at 40.35 kroons after 40.05 on trade of 2.9 million kroons.
On the secondary over-the-counter market, the Kalev confectionary company put on a sudden surge, climbing to 505 kroons from 435 kroons on big trade of 6.9 million kroons.
Saku Brewery, which issued its eight month results that showed a fall in operating profit, stayed fairly quiet.
"The Saku results were normal, we saw no surprises," Tallinna Pank dealer Tooms Tsopp told Reuters.
Saku said operating profit in the first eight months fell to 30.49 million kroons from 35 million kroons in the same period last year.
